summary: Use Fractal in iOS and shared conversation status, delivery and connection notices

replay.detail: No stored conversation events or claims are rewritten.

schema.detail: No schema, JSON field, actor kind, error code or wire value changes.

rules.detail: No registry, checkpoint or daemon rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Human rendering uses Fractal for daemon compatibility, connection failures and delivery notices. Legacy server values remain accepted and unchanged in storage and on the wire.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or new startup work.

manual.detail: No migration, re-pairing or operator action required.

recovery.detail: Recovery and retry behavior are unchanged; only human-facing wording changes.
